tasks.title: Explicit live-AI mode in the campaign harness using the production AI configuration and gateway; deterministic AI-off stays the default
artifacts: harness source changes committed locally on campaign/fresh-100
completionChecks: campaign/results/P2-IMPL-AI-MODE/result.json is valid JSON with taskId "P2-IMPL-AI-MODE", testedCommit equal to the commit recorded in state.json, a non-empty commands list with exit codes, and every listed evidence path exists
Change matches design.md and touches no product code

In production-equivalent mode, scripts/repository-compatibility/analyse.ts builds the gateway from AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL, AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY, AI_MODEL and AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN the way apps/api/src/env.ts does (no createAiGateway(undefined)) and keeps the production REPO_AI_TIMEOUT_MS path; AI-off stays an explicit diagnostic mode
The harness takes an explicit mode flag (live AI or AI off). AI off stays the default, makes no network AI request, and gives the same results as before; existing harness tests pass unchanged

Live mode reads AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL, AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY, AI_MODEL and AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN through the same config reader and createAiGateway path as apps/api; it fails fast with the missing variable names when one is absent
Each result records aiMode, the selected model name, the number of AI requests made, and the AI outcome (completed, timeout, auth error, routing error, parse error, fallback) with a sanitized error
Deterministic vitest tests cover mode selection, missing configuration, and outcome recording with a fake gateway (no network)

tasks.title: Validate production-equivalent AI: live gateway test and repository-analysis latency against the 30 s production budget
completionChecks: campaign/results/P2-AI-LIVE-VALIDATE/result.json is valid JSON with taskId "P2-AI-LIVE-VALIDATE", testedCommit equal to the commit recorded in state.json, a non-empty commands list with exit codes, and every listed evidence path exists
`DEPLOYZ_LIVE_AI=1 node --env-file=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run packages/analysis/test/ai-live.test.ts` reports 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. A skip, timeout or failure is not a pass
Latency of analyseRepositoryWithAi with the production configuration is measured over at least 3 calls and compared with REPO_AI_TIMEOUT_MS (30 s)
One Stage A run on one improvement app through the harness records aiMode production-equivalent and shows whether the AI step completed or fell back
If the call exceeds the production budget, the result is BLOCKED with that root cause and Opus records it as a product finding (Phase 4 root-cause family), not a test change
No secret value appears in any output or tracked file
Live harness run evidence shows a request count above 0 and the model name equal to the deployed production AI_MODEL (compared by equality, not printed beside credentials)
A live run with a deliberately invalid provider key (set only in the child process environment) is recorded as an auth error, not as success or silent fallback
Opus sets capability ai-gateway AVAILABLE and baseline.aiMode production-equivalent only when every check of this task passes
notes: Setup run 2026-10-08: 1/2 passed; analyseRepositoryWithAi timed out at 30 s in 3 runs. Opus sets capability ai-gateway AVAILABLE only after this task is COMPLETE.

tasks.title: Get the frozen candidate onto the control plane through the existing deployment workflow, within the publication grant
completionChecks: deploy.md names the candidate commit, the main commit that carries it, and the CI and Deploy API/Deploy web run ids, head SHAs and conclusions

The only route used is a merge to main through policy.publication.mergeProcedure (automatic deploy). If the deployed revision must change without such a merge, the task is BLOCKED with the missing authorization: workflow_dispatch of Deploy API (and Deploy web if needed) at the candidate SHA
If deploy-api skipped because no API path changed, deploy.md shows git diff --quiet <deployed/api tag> <candidate> over the deploy-api PATHS set

notes: Opus sets capability deployed-candidate AVAILABLE with the deployed-version.json identifiers only when this task is COMPLETE.
tasks.title: Verify from AWS that the control-plane components the harness uses run the candidate (read-only)
completionChecks: campaign/results/P7-VERIFY-CANDIDATE/result.json is valid JSON with taskId "P7-VERIFY-CANDIDATE", testedCommit equal to the commit recorded in state.json, a non-empty commands list with exit codes, and every listed evidence path exists
aws sts get-caller-identity returns policy.aws.account; only read-only AWS calls are used

deployed-version.json records: candidate commit; deployed/api tag SHA; stack Deployz status and LastUpdatedTime (after the deploy run start); for the API and worker Lambdas the CodeSha256, LastModified and the asset S3 key from get-template; the CodeBuild project buildspec hash; the published bootstrap template and relay artifact object keys/ETags

Lambda asset keys equal the asset hashes from a local cdk synth at the candidate commit (synth only, never deploy), and the published bootstrap template equals the candidate output; any component that cannot be matched is listed as unverified and the task is BLOCKED
A local checkout, a tag, or a green deploy job alone is not accepted as evidence

generatedTaskRules: A generated task that needs push, pull request, merge or publication lists gate publicationPolicyConfirmed and follows state.json policy.publication (mergeProcedure for any merge).
A generated task that touches real AWS lists gate awsAuthorized and requires aws-test-account and aws-login.
Generated tasks keep the holdout forbiddenInputs default unless they are Phase 6 holdout tasks.

A generated Phase 7 AWS task lists P7-VERIFY-CANDIDATE as a prerequisite, requires deployed-candidate, records the candidate commit and the deployed-version.json identifiers, and stops BLOCKED if the deployed control plane changed since verification.
